title: A Comparative Study of the Efficacy and Safety of Telitacicept and Belimumab in the Treatment of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Involving Multiple Units, Based on Previous Data.
off: Comparing Efficacy and Safety of Telitacicept and Belimumab in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: A Retrospective Multicenter Cohort Study
collabs: Affiliated Hospital of Shandong University of Traditional Chinese Medicine
summary: The objective of this observational study is to compare the efficacy and safety of tixocutibine and belizumab in the treatment of systemic lupus erythematosus in patients aged 18-65 years with systemic lupus erythematosus. The main question it aims to answer is: In the overall population of systemic lupus erythematosus: What is the response rate (SRI-4) of the two drugs in treating systemic lupus erythematosus? Which drug has better efficacy and safety? This study is a retrospective study. The participants will not receive any treatment.

arms.d: The participants in the study had previously used belimumab as a therapeutic drug.
The participants in the study had previously used telitacicept as a therapeutic drug.

primary.m: The percentage of patients with a Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Response Index-4 (SRI-4) response
primary.tf: From baseline to the end of 1-year treatment period
